note: Design only — no production code consulted. Open policy not asserted (late-submission, resubmission, TA-permission config, Observer linkage, notification channel, post-release grade change).

use_cases.name: Access Course Workspace
use_cases.main_flow: identify course+user -> validate access -> open workspace -> display syllabus/schedule/instructor/TA
use_cases.exc: registration data unavailable -> do not expose workspace

use_cases.name: Manage Course Details
use_cases.main_flow: verify Faculty auth -> edit/configure -> save/publish -> store and present

use_cases.name: Manage Course Materials
use_cases.main_flow: add file/link/note -> place in module/weekly section -> choose release timing -> validate and save -> immediate=published, future=Scheduled

use_cases.name: View Published Course Materials
use_cases.main_flow: list published materials -> open item -> display read-only

use_cases.name: Post Course Announcement
use_cases.main_flow: enter content -> verify posting authority -> submit -> timestamp and store -> visible course-wide

use_cases.name: View Course Announcements
use_cases.main_flow: retrieve announcements -> display with timestamps -> read content

use_cases.name: Create or Edit Assignment
use_cases.main_flow: create new/open existing editable -> enter due date/instructions/submission type/points -> validate -> save -> stored in Draft

use_cases.name: Publish Assignment
use_cases.main_flow: select assignment -> publish (immediate or scheduled) -> available to students per release date

use_cases.name: View Assignment
use_cases.main_flow: student views available/published assignments for course

use_cases.name: Submit Assignment
use_cases.main_flow: student chooses Submit -> use configured submission type -> before due date -> on-time submission recorded
use_cases.exc: no invalid submission recorded; late behavior unresolved (ISS-LMS-001)

use_cases.name: View Own Submission History
use_cases.main_flow: student opens submission details/history -> views own status only

use_cases.name: Grade Submission
use_cases.main_flow: open student submission -> record points and feedback -> attributed to actor

use_cases.name: Release Grades
use_cases.main_flow: Faculty chooses to release -> draft grades/feedback become Released and visible
use_cases.exc: draft grades remain hidden; TA grading alone does not release

use_cases.name: View Own Released Grade
use_cases.main_flow: student opens Grades -> views own released grade/feedback read-only

use_cases.name: Scheduled Release
use_cases.main_flow: configured release time reached -> scheduled material/assignment becomes Published/Available
